items.title: XRP traders bet on a rebound as price slips to $1 and bearish chatter surges
items.snippet: Futures open interest climbed to $2.78 billion and traders on Binance and OKX leaned heavily long, even as social sentiment hit a three-month low.
items.note: Позитивний тон для XRP за ключовими словами.

items.title: Bitcoin tops $64,000 in Asia morning hours as HYPE jumps 8% on the week
items.snippet: Every major gained on Sunday, though bitcoin, ether, XRP and solana are all lower over seven days.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Chainalysis sues US over $95M ICE contract with TRM Labs
items.snippet: The sealed complaint leaves Chainalysis’ specific objections and requested remedy undisclosed as briefing continues.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
